output_html.description: Enable HTML report generation (required for web UI / real-time dashboard).

output_json.description: Enable JSON output for programmatic access.

output_csv.description: Enable CSV output for spreadsheet or data import.

daemon_mode.description: Run as background daemon (required for real-time streaming).

use_syslog.description: Log internal messages to system syslog.

time_zone.description: Time zone to use for parsing and displaying timestamps (e.g., 'UTC', 'America/New_York').

log_format.description: Custom log format using GoAccess placeholders (%h=IP, %d=date, %r=request, etc.).

log_file.description: Primary log file path (supports wildcards for multiple files).

html_output_path.description: Path where the HTML report will be written (for static export).

ws_server.description: WebSocket server address to stream real-time updates (e.g., 'localhost:7890').

ws_ssl.description: Enable HTTPS for the WebSocket server.

ssl_cert.description: SSL certificate file path (required if ws_ssl=true).

ssl_key.description: SSL private key file path (required if ws_ssl=true).

geoip_database.description: Path to MaxMind GeoIP database file (e.g., /usr/share/GeoIP/GeoLite2-Country.mmdb). Leave empty to disable.

real_time_refresh.description: Real-time refresh interval in seconds for HTML dashboard.

items.description: Referer strings to exclude (e.g., internal referrers).

ignore_referer_list.description: List of referrer patterns to ignore in analytics.

ignore_search_engine.description: If true, exclude known search engine bots and queries from reports.

items.description: File extensions to treat as static assets and ignore in main reports.

ignore_static_extensions.description: List of static asset extensions to skip.

date_format.description: Date format in log (e.g., %Y-%m-%d for ISO dates).

http_methods.description: Comma-separated list of HTTP methods to include as requests.

items.description: HTTP status codes to consider as valid requests.

http_status_codes.description: List of HTTP status codes to count as hits.

color_scheme.description: Enable ANSI color output in CLI/TUI mode.

html_terminal.description: Enable terminal control sequences for colored HTML reports.

mouse_support.description: Enable mouse interaction in CLI mode (not applicable for daemon/web).

top_lines.description: Number of top entries to show per report section (e.g., top IPs, top URLs).

report_title.description: Title to show in HTML report header.

virtual_host.description: If true, extract and treat the host from the request line as virtual host.

items.description: Regular expression; lines matching will be skipped entirely.

skip_log_regex_list.description: List of regex patterns to exclude log lines (one per line in config).

items.description: IP address or CIDR range to exclude (e.g., '127.0.0.1', '192.168.0.0/16').

ignore_ips.description: List of IPs/CIDRs to ignore in geo and traffic analysis.

real_ip.description: If true, use IP from X-Forwarded-For header instead of client IP.

custom_404_page.description: Path to custom 404 HTML file (for embedded dashboard).

hide_requests.description: Hide requests from reports (only show summary totals).

debug_log.description: Path to write internal debug logs. Empty disables debug logging.
